corrections.title: British Columbia: Child Care Fee Reduction Initiative
corrections.quote: In B.C., 97% of eligible licensed centres participate in the program, which, along with the Affordable Child Care Benefit, has saved families more than $3 billion in fees
corrections.summary: The BC announcement describes the Child Care Fee Reduction Initiative, which lowers monthly fees at participating licensed centres. In B.C., 97% of eligible licensed centres participate in the program, saving families more than $3 billion in fees together with the Affordable Child Care Benefit. This record explains the initiative; it does not confirm an individual provider's participation or calculate a family's bill.
